alex: Proposal — run a stratified load QA for long-context + context-mix. Goal: apples-to-apples comparison between replay harness and synthetic generator with explicit prefill ratios. I sketched a protocol: https://rwd.intern/s/ctx-load-proto (draft)

mira: TL;DR? can you paste the minimal steps here so QA can eyeball quickly? :eyes:

alex: sure — short version:
1) pick 3 seq_len distributions (short, mixed, long-tail)
2) for each distro, sweep prefill_pct = [10, 40, 80] (prefill = tokens sent as prefill vs incremental)
3) run replay harness pinned to model vX.Y and synthetic generator with same token seeds + same batching args
4) ensure KV warmup pass for prefill-heavy runs (step 0-5)
5) collect per-request metrics: total_tokens, prefill_tokens, runtime_ms, kernel_choice, batch_size_tokens, cpu/gpu mem.

devon: how do we ensure kernel selection is identical across replay vs synth? runtime picks kernels based on seq_len distribution and batch packing, no?
sam: we control for that by fixing kernel_hint in the run config (cutlass|fused) and also forcing the same batch_target_tokens. That avoids the runtime auto-pivot. For apples-to-apples we need both fixed-hint and auto-hint runs.

alex: exactly. I'll include two variants: `fixed_kernel: cutlass` and `auto_kernel: true`. We compare both.

mira: can we get an example load-generator YAML to use? would speed up reproducibility.
alex: pasted config below (minimal):
```yaml
model: redwood-llm-vX.Y
kernel_hint: cutlass
batch_target_tokens: 4096
seq_dist: long_tail.json
prefill_percent: 80
replay_mode: synthetic # | replay
seeds: [42, 101, 303]
kv_warmup_steps: 5
metrics: [latency_ms, p50, p95, prefill_ratio, kernel_choice]
```

devon: perf note — in yesterday's run I saw a 12% p95 regression for prefill_pct >= 70 on the latest runtime main. Suspect KV cache warmup behavior and an extra memcpy introduced in 2026-02-27 commit.

alex: can you paste the profiler snippet? even a one-line grep helps.
devon: `grep -E "KV_CACHE|memcpy" perf-20260227.out` -> returns:
```
KV_CACHE_HIT  78%  avg_latency_prefill=96ms
memcpy_bytes_copied=1.2GB   extra_copy_path=runtime/io/kvcopy.cpp:44
```

sam: that extra copy would kill prefill-dominant workloads. For the protocol we should add a focused microbench that isolates prefill-only (100% prefill) and measures memcpy overhead with different seq lengths.

alex: added to protocol — microbench prefill-only runs with `kv_warmup_steps` sweep and an instrumented memcpy counter.

mira: who will run the canary matrix? I can pick it up after 8pm. I want the run artifacts pinned.

alex: I'll kick off the canary harness now and pin run id in the thread. Using `/replay start --matrix stratified-ctx-v1`

perf-bot: Run created: run-1745001234-stratified-ctx-v1 (canary). Commands: `/replay status run-1745001234-*`

k-qa: Quick checklist for post-run analysis:
- Verify model checkpoint hash matches (git tag)
- Compare `kernel_choice` distributions between replay and synth
- Compute `prefill_ratio = prefill_tokens / total_tokens` 
- Produce an apples-to-apples CSV with fields: run_id, seq_bin, prefill_pct, avg_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, kernel_choice_mode, memcpy_bytes

sam: suggestion — add a control where we artificially zero KV cache (cold start) vs warmed cache to quantify penalty. label as `kv_state: cold|warm`.

alex: good call. I'll include `kv_state` and set `kv_warmup_steps: 0` for cold runs.

mira: perfect. If the canary shows the memcpy regression, let's revert the copy change and re-run just the prefill microbench before wider rollout.

devon: noted. I'll open a tiny PR to gate the copy path behind a flag so we can toggle.

alex: thanks — will update the doc and drop the canary artifact link here when complete. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks all — I'll review the artifacts tonight and flag any weird kernel-choice mismatches.

perf-bot: Canary finished: run-1745001234-stratified-ctx-v1 -> artifacts at https://perf.rwd/run/1745001234 (status: partial)

alex: pinned run run-1745001234 to the doc. next: schedule weekly sweep if results are noisy.

mira: ack.
